world.title: Russian 'Bears' return to Vietnam after 12 years: Why Moscow's Tu-95 deployment matters
world.summary: Russia has reintroduced its Tu-95 nuclear-capable strategic bombers to Vietnam after a 12-year hiatus, reinstating a military agreement that previously enabled Moscow to operate long-range aircraft in the area. This deployment may enhance Russia's military presence in Southeast Asia, allowing its bombers to operate closer to potential targets, thereby impacting regional security dynamics and international relations.

world.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea amass forces along border, heightening war fears, sources say
world.summary: Ethiopia and Eritrea have gathered military forces along their shared border, according to conflict monitors and militia sources in northern Ethiopia's Tigray region. This buildup has raised concerns about the potential for renewed conflict between the two nations, which have a history of rivalry. The situation remains tense as both sides prepare for possible escalation.

world.title: US used expired Tomahawks against Iran by changing operation codes of old missiles
world.summary: The US Navy has confirmed using expired Tomahawk cruise missiles in its operations against Iran, prompting concerns about the condition of its munitions stockpiles. Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao's comments highlight the challenges posed by an increasing reliance on aging missiles amid a significant shortage of available weaponry, raising questions about operational readiness and safety.

business.title: Indian equities see record $10.6 billion FII inflows in Nov so far; here's why brokerages are bullish
business.summary: Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) have invested a record $10.6 billion in Indian equities in November, exceeding the previous high of $8.4 billion from December 2020. This significant inflow reflects renewed confidence in the Indian market, prompting brokerages to adopt a bullish outlook. The surge highlights a strong recovery in foreign investment interest in the Indian stock market.

business.title: Top 15 Electric Scooters Oct 2026 India - Chetak, iQube, Rizta, Vida
business.summary: In October 2026, Bajaj Chetak emerged as the top-selling electric scooter in India. The combined sales of TVS iQube and TVS Orbiter reached nearly 70,000 units, surpassing Bajaj’s overall retail volumes. The total electric two-wheeler sales in the month hit a record high of 2.24 lakh units, reflecting significant growth in the electric scooter market.

business.title: RBI The Competent Authority, Not ICICI Bank's Board: Bombay High Court While Quashing Sanction To Prosecute Chanda Kochhar
business.summary: The Bombay High Court quashed the sanction issued by ICICI Bank's Board of Directors for the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) to prosecute former CEO Chanda Kochhar under the Prevention of Corruption Act. The court ruled that the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is the competent authority in such matters, not the bank's board.

technology.title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+: Light, lean and laptop-like
technology.summary: The Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ is a premium, portable tablet designed for productivity, featuring laptop-like capabilities and strong media performance. It offers long software support, appealing to users seeking versatility in a lightweight device. While many tablets claim to replace laptops, the Tab S12+ aims for a more modest approach, balancing functionality with a premium price tag.

technology.title: GTA VI takes over an NBA court. How Vice City became a real-world spectacle
technology.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI has gained significant attention globally, with gamers in New Zealand already exploring Vice City. The game's launch has created a buzz, leading to various real-world promotions, including an NBA court takeover. Millions of players worldwide are eagerly anticipating the release, marking a notable moment in gaming culture as Rockstar's latest installment captures widespread interest.

technology.title: Google expands Gemini Tasks to millions of users, adds calling and shopping features
technology.summary: Google has expanded its Gemini Tasks, an AI-powered assistant feature, to millions of users. This update allows the assistant to perform multi-step actions, such as making calls to businesses, comparing prices, and assisting with purchases. The rollout aims to enhance user experience by streamlining various tasks, making it easier for users to manage their daily activities efficiently.

sports.title: MS Dhoni's IPL career in numbers
sports.summary: MS Dhoni's IPL career is marked by significant achievements, including five titles as captain of the Chennai Super Kings. His leadership and performance have made him one of the league's greatest players. The article highlights key statistics and milestones from his career, showcasing his impact on the tournament and contributions to the team's success over the years.

sports.title: SMAT 2026: Dhull's blazing ton in vain as Bihar stun Delhi
sports.summary: In the SMAT 2026 tournament, Bihar defeated Delhi, while Haryana triumphed over Tamil Nadu and Vidarbha won against Hyderabad. Chhattisgarh's captain Vikalp Tiwari scored 119 runs off 56 balls, leading his team to a 51-run victory against Odisha. Tiwari hit 18 fours and three sixes before retiring hurt, contributing significantly to his team's success.

sports.title: Arshdeep Singh makes big jump in ODI bowling rankings, Rohit Sharma slips after New Zealand series
sports.summary: India fast bowler Arshdeep Singh has advanced 12 positions in the ICC ODI bowling rankings, now sharing 19th place with teammate Axar Patel. This improvement follows his performance in the recent series against New Zealand. Conversely, Indian captain Rohit Sharma has slipped in the rankings, reflecting the competitive nature of the ODI format and player performances.

health.title: What a lump in your armpit could mean: An oncologist explains
health.summary: A lump in the armpit can cause concern, but it does not always indicate breast cancer. Various factors may contribute to its presence, and specific symptoms should be monitored. It is crucial to seek medical advice if the lump persists or is accompanied by other symptoms. Understanding these aspects can help alleviate anxiety regarding potential health issues.

health.title: The DRC’s Ebola outbreak remains out of control
health.summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak is worsening, spreading rapidly despite increased funding. The situation is exacerbated by rampant misinformation, widespread violence, and insufficient medical equipment. The current outbreak is reportedly more fatal due to a lack of available treatments and vaccines. Efforts to control the disease face significant challenges, hindering effective response measures and public health initiatives.

health.title: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years
health.summary: The United States has lost its measles elimination status after 26 years, according to the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO). This decline is part of a broader trend, as Bolivia and Mexico have also lost their elimination status. The increase in measles cases globally raises concerns about public health and vaccination efforts, particularly in regions with low immunization rates.

science.title: Cornell scientists studied how 2,839 fish species swim together; their analysis found group swimming evolved around 60 times but disappeared about 320 times
science.summary: A Cornell University study analyzed 2,839 fish species, revealing that group swimming has independently evolved approximately 60 times. Despite the advantages of collective behavior, this trait has disappeared around 320 times across various species. The research highlights the complex evolutionary dynamics of fish movement, with about 79 percent of species exhibiting collective swimming, while others prefer solitary habits.

science.title: Voyager 1 Becomes First Human-Made Object to Reach One Light-Day from Earth
science.summary: Voyager 1 has made history as the first human-made object to reach one light-day from Earth, achieving this milestone on November 18 at 5:16 AM EST. The spacecraft is now approximately 25.9 billion kilometers away. This achievement highlights nearly 50 years of interstellar exploration and scientific discovery, showcasing the advancements in space technology and human ingenuity.

science.title: Genomic breakthrough offers new hope for southern corroboree frog
science.summary: Researchers have demonstrated that genomic selection, a breeding technique commonly used in agriculture, could enhance the resilience of the southern corroboree frog, one of Australia's most endangered species, against a lethal disease. This breakthrough marks the first application of this method to improve the survival prospects of the frog, potentially aiding conservation efforts for this threatened amphibian.

entertainment.title: Hindu Janajagruti Samiti urges Hindus to skip ‘Ramayana’, seeks special screening of part 2- Report
entertainment.summary: The Hindu Janajagruti Samiti (HJS) has expressed strong objections to the recently released film 'Ramayana', claiming it distorts Maharshi Valmiki’s epic. The group alleges that the film glorifies Ravana and misrepresents Lord Ram and Lakshman. HJS has urged Hindus to boycott the film and is seeking a special screening of part two to address these concerns.

entertainment.title: TV Proposal To Marriage: How Ramayana's Ravi Dubey Found His Forever Partner In Sargun Mehta
entertainment.summary: Ravi Dubey, known for his role as Lakshman in Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana, gained renewed attention for his personal life. He and Sargun Mehta first met on a television set in 2009 and developed a relationship over the years. The couple married four years later, solidifying their bond as they continue to navigate their careers in the entertainment industry.

entertainment.title: Sidharth Malhotra and Kiara Advani request privacy after daughter Saraayah’s face appears in airport video
entertainment.summary: Sidharth Malhotra and Kiara Advani have requested privacy following the appearance of their one-year-old daughter, Saraayah, in an airport video. The couple has kept their child away from public attention and urged paparazzi and social media users to avoid sharing images or videos that reveal her face. They emphasize the importance of respecting their family's privacy.
